objectives.en: Write enqueue, dequeue, isEmpty, size and peek
Simulate a real queue in Python

narration.en: A Python list can be a queue too. Add with append() at the end, and remove from index 0 with pop(0).
narration.kn: ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಕ್ಯೂ ಆಗಿಯೂ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. append() ನಿಂದ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, pop(0) ನಿಂದ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ 0 ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.

body.en: Create an empty list, myQueue = list(). enqueue(myQueue, element) uses append(), so the end of the list is the REAR. isEmpty returns True when len(myQueue) == 0. dequeue checks isEmpty and then returns myQueue.pop(0), the FRONT element; otherwise it reports that the queue is empty. size returns len(myQueue), and peek returns myQueue[0]. IS FULL is not needed because a Python list grows as required.

narration.en: Create an empty list, myQueue = list(). enqueue(myQueue, element) uses append(), so the end of the list is the REAR. isEmpty returns True when len(myQueue) == 0. dequeue checks isEmpty and then returns myQueue.pop(0), the FRONT element; otherwise it reports that the queue is empty. size returns len(myQueue), and peek returns myQueue[0]. IS FULL is not needed because a Python list grows as required.
narration.kn: myQueue = list(). enqueue: append(); dequeue: isEmpty ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ pop(0); size: len(); peek: myQueue[0]. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ IS FULL ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: A queue built on a Python list

say.en: We use a list. append adds at the end of the list, so the end is the REAR. Index 0 is the FRONT.
enqueue is myQueue dot append of element.
dequeue first checks isEmpty, then returns myQueue dot pop of 0, the front element.
size is len of myQueue, and peek returns myQueue of 0.

narration.en: We map the FRONT and REAR of a queue onto a Python list and write each operation as one list method.

prompt.en: Match each queue operation with the list code that implements it.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಯೂ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅದನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಕೋಡ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: The end of the list is the REAR, so append adds there; index 0 is the FRONT, so pop(0) removes the oldest element and myQueue[0] peeks at it. dequeue and peek must first check isEmpty.
explanation.kn: ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಕೊನೆ REAR, ಸೂಚಿ 0 FRONT. append ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, pop(0) ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
